per_case.question: What was our total booking revenue in October, and how many confirmed bookings did we have?
per_case.answer: October booking revenue was $3,608 across 109 confirmed bookings.
per_case.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS booking_revenue_dollars, COUNT(*) AS confirmed_bookings FROM analyst.bookings WHERE club_id = 1 AND status = 'confirmed' AND starts_at >= '2026-10-01' AND starts_at < '2026-11-01' LIMIT 200

per_case.question: Who were our top 3 members by number of bookings in September?
per_case.answer: The top 3 members by bookings in September were Blake Kowal with 14, Xen Ostrow with 7, and Emerson Thorne with 6.
per_case.sql: SELECT p.display_name, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM analyst.bookings AS b JOIN analyst.profiles AS p ON p.user_id = b.user_id WHERE b.club_id = 1 AND b.starts_at >= '2026-09-01' AND b.starts_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY b.user_id, p.display_name ORDER BY booking_count DESC LIMIT 3

per_case.question: What share of our bookings were no-shows?
per_case.answer: No-show rates by club ranged from 3.5% to 5.3%: Lakeside Paddle 5.3% (15 of 281), Midtown Tennis Center 3.5% (10 of 283), Peachtree Pickleball 4.6% (17 of 368), and Riverside Racquet Club 4.8% (17 of 355).
per_case.sql: SELECT c.name AS club_name, COUNT(*) AS total_bookings, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE b.status = 'no_show') AS no_shows, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE b.status = 'no_show') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS no_show_pct FROM analyst.bookings AS b JOIN analyst.clubs AS c ON c.id = b.club_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 200

per_case.question: Which of our courts gets booked the most? Count all bookings, including cancelled ones.
per_case.answer: Court 1 at Riverside Racquet Club gets booked the most, with 95 bookings (including cancelled ones). Court 2 follows with 93.
per_case.sql: SELECT co.name AS court_name, cl.name AS club_name, COUNT(b.id) AS booking_count FROM analyst.courts AS co JOIN analyst.clubs AS cl ON cl.id = co.club_id LEFT JOIN analyst.bookings AS b ON b.court_id = co.id WHERE co.club_id = 1 GROUP BY co.id, co.name, cl.name ORDER BY booking_count DESC LIMIT 200
